parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: SecurityIpGroupName
parameters.description:
The group name of the whitelist group of IP addresses.

It starts with lowercase letters and ends with lowercase letters or numbers. It can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, and should be 2~32 characters in length.

parameters.name: SecurityIps
parameters.description:
The list of IP addresses in the whitelist group.

It is a JSON array. Each object in the array is an IP address or a CIDR block. You can have up to 40 whitelists.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro create-tenant-security-ip-group --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id t4louaeei0000 --security-ip-group-name paytest --security-ips 192.000.0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro CreateTenantSecurityIpGroup --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4louaeei0000 --SecurityIps '192.000.0.0' --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SecurityIpGroupName paytest
